questions.q: Which actor plays the villain Ra.One in the 2011 film?
questions.why: Arjun Rampal plays the self-learning game villain who escapes into the real world.

questions.q: Under which gaming alias does Prateek reach the final level before Ra.One breaks out?
questions.why: Prateek logs in as Lucifer, and Ra.One, unable to finish its match, decides Lucifer must die.

questions.q: Which ability, along with mind reading, does Ra.One have that lets him impersonate people?
questions.why: Ra.One was designed with shapeshifting, mind reading and a self-learning AI, so he takes the forms of Akashi and Sonia.

questions.q: Which actor plays Akashi, the motion-capture artist whose form Ra.One first takes?
questions.why: Tom Wu plays Akashi; Jackie Chan had been approached but declined.

questions.q: How does G.One spot the real Ra.One among ten identical apparitions?
options: Only one of them has a shadow
Only one of them is actually breathing
questions.why: G.One remembers Shekhar's warning, and only the genuine apparition casts a shadow.

questions.q: Ra.One hypnotises and then impersonates which character, played by Kareena Kapoor?
questions.why: Ra.One takes Sonia Subramaniam's form to kidnap her son Prateek.

questions.q: Which international singer features on the Ra.One song 'Criminal'?
questions.why: The Vishal-Shekhar track 'Criminal' features Akon, alongside hits like 'Chammak Challo'.

questions.q: Who supervised the VFX of Ra.One?
questions.why: Jeffrey Kleiser supervised the effects for the film, which won the National Award for special effects.

questions.q: For which craft did Ra.One win both a National Film Award and a Filmfare Award?
questions.why: The film won a National Award and a Filmfare Award, both for Best Special Effects.

questions.q: Who produced Ra.One under the banner Red Chillies Entertainment?
questions.why: Gauri Khan produced the film directed by Anubhav Sinha.
